title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Kai Trump Miami Debut
items.text: Kai Trump made her University of Miami debut at the Golfweek Fall Challenge, shooting 7-over 78 after returning from wrist surgery, starting her freshman collegiate season.

items.headline: Justin Thomas Presidents Cup
items.text: Justin Thomas was selected to play for Team USA in the 2026 Presidents Cup, preparing for another international appearance.

items.headline: PGA Tour Putter Patterns
items.text: The 2026 PGA Tour season ended revealing a clear pattern in the putters used by tournament winners, highlighting equipment trends.
